must_fix.issue: EventAccumulator can silently stop at a truncated or CRC-corrupt trailing TFRecord after all required core steps already appeared. Current extractor has no strict framing/CRC/EOF verification and may mark scalar integrity complete despite discarded trailing records.
must_fix.evidence: Official upstream RawEventFileLoader.Load catches DataLossError and breaks; compat record reader raises DataLossError for corrupt CRC and truncated header/body. Root did not execute bad samples or inspect the pinned image copy.
must_fix.required_change: Preserve v1 and create revised source with strict streaming TFRecord header/body masked CRC32C, record length/offset and complete EOF validation before extraction; failed diagnostics retained. Plot/acceptance must require these whole-file proofs.

scope_boundaries: Upstream source data-flow finding only, not empirical confirmation of the future pinned Docker library version.
No import/execution of new scientific helpers, no event parsing, no synthetic native completion or model result.
Same-run binding, exact core steps, nonfinite diagnostics, conditional coverage and gaps in plotting were inspected; they do not compensate for missing file-integrity proof.
Large fine SVG and scalar JSON may exceed25MB; future publication must archive all large items losslessly, as communicated to its author.
